title: euphorbia verrucosa var. lanuginosa
intro: Euphorbia verrucosa var. lanuginosa, commonly known as woolly-leaved spurge, is a succulent plant species belonging to the Euphorbiaceae family. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, making it a promising treatment for various health conditions. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as triterpenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are known to exhibit anti-cancer, anti-diabetic, and anti-inflammatory effects. The bioactive constituents present in woolly-leaved spurge have also been reported to possess antioxidant, anti-microbial, and anti-viral properties, further supporting its therapeutic potential.
